about: Hand verification of every capitalised keyword against the audio (Phase 1). 'start' is the verified time and is always used; 'auto_when_verified' is what the automatic aligner gave at inspection time. Because the audio is fixed, the verified times stay valid when the automatic pipeline is re-run; s06_timing.py reports the distance between the current automatic result and each verified start (and warns above 120 ms). Convention: start = onset of the first sung note (vowel / pitch onset), attack = leading consonant.
method: check_keywords.py (per-word spectrogram + f0 + novelty) and check_lines.py (line context, syllable counting against f0 notes and the 16th grid)
